divergences.description: The filter sheet leaves out the "CATEGORIA" chip group entirely. FR-004 and T024 require it to be rendered (inert) for visual fidelity, and T028 scenario #3 was to test it. The new test instead checks that it is absent.

The filter sheet has no "Limpar" button. FR-003, T024 and Story 2 Acceptance Scenario 3 require one that resets the sheet's own selections without closing it. Only "Aplicar" exists, and the test checks that "Limpar" is absent.

The date-range group is labeled "PERÍODO" instead of "INTERVALO DE DATA" and is placed after "TIPO DE ENTRADA". This differs from the planned groups and order (INTERVALO DE DATA / CATEGORIA / TIPO DE ENTRADA, per the RNF08 row).

A new persistent on-device cache (EntriesLocalCache, backed by flutter_secure_storage) is added and registered in DI. It is injected into EntriesRepositoryImpl, which now persists every created, listed and searched entry. The plan explicitly states "No new persistence... no new secure-storage key" and "1 DI registration unchanged".

On a failed first page load, RecordsBloc now falls back to showing the repository's cachedEntries (with nextCursor null and a pageLoadFailure) instead of emitting RecordsLoadFailure. This changes RF07's first-load behavior, which the plan does not cover.
ApiClient's client-side timeout and offline failures now carry fixed Portuguese user-facing messages instead of Dio's e.message. This is a core network change outside the unit's scope.
A new offline note ("Busca limitada ao que está salvo no aparelho.") is shown under the search bar on NetworkOfflineFailure. This UI is not in the plan or the spec.

The active-filter chips use hardcoded Color values defined outside design_tokens.dart. This breaks the plan's "zero visual values hardcoded outside design_tokens.dart / zero new color tokens" constraint (Principle IV/RNF08).
"Limpar filtros" resets the bloc's query, but the search TextField has no controller and is never cleared, so the old search text stays visible after FR-007's "clear any active search text".
The funnel icon is always Icons.filter_alt. T032 says to swap between the neutral RF07 icon (filter_alt_outlined) and the filled variant; only the colors change.
The isApplyingCriteria loading indicator appears as soon as a criteria fetch starts. The plan says it should appear only once a fetch takes longer than 300 ms (RNF01 threshold).

divergences.description: Added a new on-device persistence layer (EntriesLocalCache, backed by FlutterSecureStorage under a new 'entriesLocalCache' key), registered in DI and injected into EntriesRepositoryImpl. Every successful create/list/search now writes into it. The plan says the opposite: 'No new persistence... no new secure-storage key', and offline display was supposed to need no new code (R7). A side effect: cachedEntries now holds every entry ever fetched, and _fetchNextPage still merges cachedEntries in as secondary, so entries that don't match the active filters can leak into a filtered list.

Changed the first-page load failure path in _loadFirstPage, which the plan didn't cover. When cached entries exist, it now emits RecordsLoaded from the on-device cache (with pageLoadFailure, or with no failure on auth expiry) instead of RecordsLoadFailure.
Changed ApiClient's client-side timeout and offline failure messages from Dio's e.message to fixed Portuguese user-facing strings. This shared core network change is not in the plan.

The filter sheet does not render the 'CATEGORIA' chip group (trabalho/rotina/descanso/relações). FR-004 and T024 require it to be rendered for visual fidelity, even though it must not filter anything. A test asserts that it is absent.
The filter sheet has no 'Limpar' button for resetting its local selections, which FR-003, Story 2 Scenario 3 and T024 require. Only 'Aplicar' exists, and a test asserts that 'Limpar' is absent.
The date-range group is labelled 'PERÍODO' instead of the planned 'INTERVALO DE DATA' (RNF08). It is also placed after 'TIPO DE ENTRADA', reversing the planned group order.

Added an offline note under the search bar ('Busca limitada ao que está salvo no aparelho.'), shown whenever pageLoadFailure or criteriaLoadFailure is a NetworkOfflineFailure. This UI is not in the plan.

The active-filter chips use hardcoded Color literals that are not in DesignTokens. This violates the plan's constraint of 'Zero visual values hardcoded outside design_tokens.dart' and 'reuse existing tokens only'.
